# Amos Chapter 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folio 335v | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/AMO_004_page_001.jpg

---

**4:1** Hear [shimna] this word [ha-davar], O-cows [parot] of-the-Bashan [ha-Bashan], who [are] on-the-mountain [be-har] of-Shomron [Samaria], those-who-oppress [ha-oshqot] the-poor [dallim], those-who-crush [ha-rotsetsot] the-needy [evyonim], those-who-say [ha-omerot] to-their-lords [la-adoneihem], "Bring [havi'ah] and-let-us-drink [venishteh]!"

**4:2** Sworn [nishba] has the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH by-his-holiness [be-qodsho]: "Behold, days [yamim] [are] coming [ba'im] upon-you when-they-will-lift-you [venissa etkhem] with-hooks [be-tsinnot] and-your-remnant [acharitekhem] with-fishhooks [be-sirot dugah]."

**4:3** "And-through-breaches [u-feratsiym] you-will-go-out [tetsenah], each-woman [ishah] straight-ahead [negdah], and-you-will-be-flung [vehishlakhtenah] to-Harmon [ha-Harmonah]," declares YHWH.

**4:4** "Come [bo'u] to-Beit-El [Bethel] and-transgress [ufish'u]; to-Gilgal, multiply [harbu] transgressing [lifshoa]; and-bring [havi'u] in-the-morning [la-boqer] your-sacrifices [zivheikhem], every-three-days [li-shloshet yamim] your-tithes [ma'seroteikhem]."

**4:5** "And-burn [veqatteru] from-leavened-bread [me-chamets] a-thanksgiving [todah], and-proclaim [veqir'u] freewill-offerings [nedavot], announce [hashmi'u] — for so you-love [ahavtem], O-sons of-Yisra'el," declares the-Lord [Adonai] YHWH.

**4:6** "And-also I, I-gave [natati] you cleanness [niqqayon] of-teeth [shinnayim] in-all your-cities [areikhem] and-lack [vechoser] of-bread [lechem] in-all your-places [meqomoteikhem]; and-you-did-not return [lo shavtem] to-me," declares YHWH.

**4:7** "And-also I withheld [manati] from-you the-rain [ha-geshem] when-still [be-od] three-months to-the-harvest [la-qatsir]; and-I-caused-it-to-rain [vehimtarti] on one city [ir achat], and-on another city I-did-not cause-rain [lo amtir]; one-piece [chelqah achat] was-rained-on [timater], and-the-piece on-which it-did-not rain withered [tivash]."

**4:8** "And-staggered [vena'u] two [or] three cities to one city to-drink [lishtot] water [mayim], and-were-not satisfied [velo yisba'u]; and-you-did-not return to-me," declares YHWH.

**4:9** "I-struck-you [hikkeiti etkhem] with-blight [ba-shiddafon] and-with-mildew [u-va-yerakon]; the-many [harbeh] of-your-gardens [ganoteikhem] and-your-vineyards [vekharmeikem] and-your-fig-trees [u-te'eneikhem] and-your-olive-trees [ve-zeitheikhem] the-locust [ha-gazam] devoured [yokhel]; and-you-did-not return to-me," declares YHWH.

**4:10** "I-sent [shillachti] against-you plague [dever] in-the-way [be-derekh] of-Mitsrayim [Egypt]; I-killed [haragti] your-young-men [bachureikhem] with-the-sword [ba-cherev] together-with the-capture [im shevi] of-your-horses [suseikhem]; and-I-caused-to-rise [va'aleh] the-stench [be'osh] of-your-camps [machaneikem] in-your-nostrils [be-apekhem]; and-you-did-not return to-me," declares YHWH.

**4:11** "I-overthrew [hafakhti] among-you as-God-overthrew [ke-mahpekat elohim] Sedom [Sodom] and-Amorah [Gomorrah], and-you-were like-a-brand [ke-ud] plucked [mutssal] from-a-burning [mi-serefah]; and-you-did-not return to-me," declares YHWH.

**4:12** "Therefore, thus I-will-do [e'eseh] to-you, O-Yisra'el; because [eqev] this I-will-do to-you — prepare [hikkon] to-meet [liqrat] your-God [elohekha], O-Yisra'el!"

**4:13** For behold, the-one-who-forms [yotser] mountains [harim] and-creates [u-vorei] wind [ruach], and-declares [u-maggid] to-man [le-adam] what [is] his-thought [seicho]; who-makes [oseh] dawn [shachar] darkness [eifah], and-treads [vedorekh] upon the-high-places [bamotei] of-the-earth [arets]: YHWH, God of-Hosts [Elohei Tseva'ot] [is] his-name.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.1 — "Cows of Bashan":** Bashan (modern Golan Heights) was famed for its fat cattle. Amos addresses the wealthy women of Samaria who demand luxury from their husbands while the poor are crushed. The address is deliberately shocking.

**v.6-11 — The five refusals:** Famine (v.6), drought (v.7-8), crop disease and locusts (v.9), plague and war (v.10), near-total destruction (v.11) — each ends with the devastating refrain: *velo shavtem adai* ("and you did not return to me"). Five warnings, five refusals.

**v.12 — "Prepare to meet your God":** The climax. Often quoted in isolation as evangelism; in context, it is a terrifying summons to judgment.

*— EMET*
